scope: Six self-review streams covering seven Tokutei sectors. Each stream completed at least three bounded groups; no cross-author semantic review is inferred.

preservation: Sector-specific checks preserve old IDs, exam banks, locale fields and learner-state contracts; added content uses explicit bindings and version isolation where required.

macSync.rule: User must execute guarded sync in the actual Mac clone; it refuses dirty tracked work or divergent history.

publication: Root uploads exact file blobs, verifies their Git object IDs and the complete staged tree, updates the remote branch with a parent lease, then fetches/fast-forwards and runs the persistence gate. The resulting enclosing commit is the snapshot identity.
